entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-10-31
entry.content:
Azure.AI.Projects_3.0.0-beta.6

3.0.0-beta.6 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Added opt-in Voice Agent realtime tracing for connections, sessions, responses, tool milestones, audio usage, cancellation, and errors using the existing Foundry GenAI tracing settings. Added correlated, payload-free realtime diagnostic logs.
  • Included first-text/audio latency, reported audio formats and sample rates, session audio totals, consistent session lifecycle events, and bounded opt-in transcript/tool message content in Voice Agent telemetry.
  • Added the MaxSamples property to SimulationSeedDataGenerationJobConfiguration.

Breaking Changes

  • SimulationSeedDataGenerationJobConfiguration now requires a maxSamples constructor argument. Replace parameterless construction with new SimulationSeedDataGenerationJobConfiguration(maxSamples).
  • Added an optional maxSamples parameter to AzureAIProjectsModelFactory.SimulationSeedDataGenerationJobConfiguration, changing its binary signature. Recompile code that uses this factory.

Sample Updates

  • Added runnable Voice Agent REST and realtime telemetry samples using the existing Foundry tracing settings, OpenTelemetry console exporter, and correlated realtime diagnostic logs.

Azure.AI.Extensions.OpenAI_3.0.0-beta.6

3.0.0-beta.6 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Exposed the constructors of GitHubCopilotToolsetPreview, GitHubCopilotToolsetDefaultConfig GitHubCopilotToolsetConfig, MicrosoftCopilotToolsetPreview, MicrosoftCopilotToolsetDefaultConfig and MicrosoftCopilotToolsetConfig.

Breaking Changes

  • BrowserAutomationPreviewTool is deprecated and hidden from IntelliSense. Please use BrowserAutomationTool instead.
  • Removed the type parameter from response-item methods on ExtensionsOpenAIModelFactory. Each factory now uses the discriminator value for its concrete response-item type.

Sample Updates

  • Added sample for Hosted Agent identity isolation.

Azure.AI.Projects.Agents_3.0.0-beta.6

3.0.0-beta.6 (2026-10-30)

Features Added

  • Added experimental Voice Agent post-call delivery to Event Grid connections and routines.
  • Added experimental Voice Agent soundscapes for telephony ambience and event cues.
  • Added Azure Speech streaming transcription and headset/personal noise suppression modes.
  • Added ProjectsAgentProtocol.VoiceConversationEngine for hosted voice conversation engines.
  • Enriched existing Foundry GenAI agent-creation traces with privacy-safe Voice Agent metadata and bounded instruction content under the existing opt-in setting. Other Voice Agent REST operations retain their existing SDK diagnostics.

Breaking Changes

  • Added the postCall parameter before store in ProjectsAgentsModelFactory.VoiceAgentDefinition, affecting positional arguments.
  • Added the soundscape parameter before outputModalities in ProjectsAgentsModelFactory.VoiceAgentDefinition, affecting positional arguments.
  • VoiceAgentAvatarVideoCrop.BottomRight and VoiceAgentAvatarVideoCrop.TopLeft types were changed from IList<object> to IList<uint>.
  • VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadEnTurnDetection.IdleTimeoutMs was renamed to VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadEnTurnDetection.IdleTimeout.
  • VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadMultilingualTurnDetection.IdleTimeoutMs was renamed to VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadMultilingualTurnDetection.IdleTimeout.
  • VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadTurnDetection.IdleTimeoutMs was renamed to VoiceAgentAzureSemanticVadTurnDetection.IdleTimeout.
  • VoiceAgentSubagent.InvokeTimeoutSeconds was renamed to VoiceAgentSubagent.InvokeTimeout.
  • OtlpTelemetryEndpoint.Endpoint type was changed from string to System.Uri.
  • VoiceAgentMcpTool.AllowedTools and MCPToolboxTool.AllowedTools, along with their model-factory parameters, now use OpenAI.Responses.McpToolFilter instead of BinaryData. MCPToolboxTool.AllowedTools now requires the AAIP002 experimental opt-in.
  • VoiceResult.Metadata now uses IDictionary<string, BinaryData> instead of OpenAI.InternalMetadataContainer. The public OpenAI.InternalMetadataContainer type was removed.
  • BrowserAutomationPreviewToolboxTool is deprecated and hidden from IntelliSense. Please use BrowserAutomationToolboxTool instead.
  • VoiceAgentSoundscapeSound was converted from enumeration to structure allowing extensibility from the service side.
  • The VoiceAgentSoundscapeWorkingTrackConfig property DelayMs was renamed to Delay.

entry.title: microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml - Releases - 2026-10-31
entry.content:
WinUI 3 in WinAppSDK 2.6.4

WinUI 3 in Windows App SDK 2.6.4 includes reliability fixes for text controls during app shutdown, ItemsView, and WebView2, plus a fix for false IntelliSense errors in VS Code. It is available through the Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.6.4 NuGet package.

Bug fixes:

  • Fixed an access violation crash that could occur during app shutdown when a text control, such as a TextBox or RichEditBox, was still alive while the XAML core was being torn down.
  • Fixed a crash in ItemsView when the target of StartBringItemIntoView was collapsed or recycled before the scroll completed (microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml#11865).
  • Fixed a crash that could occur when a WebView2 control received focus while still initializing and its parent window was temporarily disabled when initialization finished.
  • Fixed false IntelliSense errors on XAML-generated members, such as InitializeComponent and x:Name fields, in WinUI 3 C# projects edited in VS Code with C# Dev Kit. To opt out, set the EnableWinUIDesignTimeGeneratedXamlCompileItems property to false.

For the full set of changes across Windows App SDK 2.6.4, see the Windows App SDK 2.6.4 release notes.

Try it out

  • Install the Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.6.4 NuGet package.
  • Download and update the WinUI Gallery to see the WinUI 3 updates firsthand.

entry.title: StackExchange/StackExchange.Redis - Releases - 2026-10-31
entry.content:
4.0.155-alpha

V4 preview. Since 4.0.146-alpha:

  • high-integrity mode restored — a sequence check behind every command (#3308)
  • client-side caching replaces a TimeToLive-expired entry on the next fill rather than waiting for the sweep (#3318, #3320)
  • an ASK re-send keeps CLIENT CACHING out of the prefix and exempts ASKING from the sequence check (#3319)
  • cluster failover recovery — the library's own topology refresh is exempt from the AllowAdmin gate, a replica-write refusal marks the slot map suspect, and losing an established connection prompts a reconfigure (#3324, from the #3323 investigation)
  • the connect wait covers the eagerly-dialled subscription connection (#3325)
  • HOTKEYS and CLIENT KILL write through IRespArgument operands (#3321)
  • plus main merged in up to 3.4.29 (#3322)
